Did the quartet play an encore? The recording covers the entire concert and ends with an encore by all four players.
Was the copper disk magnetic? The label was missing. The case beside it contained a magnet, but no one tested the disk.
Was booth five occupied at noon? The noon panorama shows its whole interior empty.
Was the last page signed? The legal assistant inspected the original and saw the signature on its last page.
Did sanding cause the variation in gloss? Both the coating and sanding technique changed, and only the finished pieces were compared.
Did the clock chime at ten? The bell was disconnected all morning. The hands showed ten without any sound.
